summary: Space Bunny is free on OpenCode Zen for a limited time. Announced by @opencode on 2026-09-23 as "free for the next week" (through ~2026-09-30). OpenCode's docs list model id space-bunny-free on the Zen chat-completions endpoint and note that its provider follows a zero-retention policy and does not use your data for model training. The announcement lists 1M context, multi-modal support, and zero data retention.
claim_steps: Sign in to OpenCode Zen at opencode.ai/zen and copy your API key.
In the OpenCode TUI, run /connect, select OpenCode Zen, and paste your API key.
Run /models and select Space Bunny Free (model id: space-bunny-free).
